name: FlowSeek
plain: FlowSeek (University of Bologna, 2025), size T: SEA-RAFT optical flow that also uses a frozen Depth Anything V2 Small: its features help the matching and its depth tells which flow a camera motion would cause. Apache-2.0 code; the authors' weights carry no separate licence.
summary: FlowSeek (Poggi & Tosi 2025), size T: SEA-RAFT (ResNet18 encoders, initial flow regression, ConvNeXt update block, 4 iterations) helped by a frozen Depth Anything V2 Small. Its features join the matching features, and its relative depth gives 8 motion bases (the flow fields that camera translations and rotations would cause), which a third encoder turns into extra context. Each image is resized to 518 x 518 for Depth Anything, whatever the input size. The authors' released weights; the network is ported from mattpoggi/flowseek. `iters=12` is the paper's FlowSeek (S). The larger M and L sizes use Depth Anything V2 Base, whose weights are non-commercial, and are not included.

papers.title: FlowSeek: Optical Flow Made Easier with Depth Foundation Models and Motion Bases

no_kernels_reason: no kernels mode was built for it; SEA-RAFT's engine and the Depth Anything kernels would fit and could be combined
task_io: Input: two RGB images (consecutive frames). Output: per-pixel motion from the first to the second (dx, dy in pixels).
